test_cases.title: Claim one smallest increment below 1,000 is not high value
preconditions: The system accepts claim amounts to two decimal places.
The claim category limit is 1,100.00.
steps: Submit a claim for 999.99.
test_cases.expected_result: The claim is not classified or routed with reason code HIGH_VALUE. The acceptance criteria do not specify its overall routing outcome.

test_cases.title: Claim exactly 1,000 is not high value
preconditions: The claim category limit is 1,100.00.
steps: Submit a claim for 1,000.00.
test_cases.expected_result: The claim is not classified as high value. The acceptance criteria do not specify its overall routing outcome.

test_cases.title: Claim one smallest increment above 1,000 is sent for manual review
preconditions: The system accepts claim amounts to two decimal places.
The claim category limit is 1,100.00.
steps: Submit a claim for 1,000.01.
test_cases.expected_result: The claim is not recommended for automatic approval and is routed to manual_review with reason code HIGH_VALUE.

test_cases.title: Claim immediately below its category limit is high value
preconditions: The system accepts claim amounts to two decimal places.
The claim category limit is 1,100.00.
steps: Submit a claim for 1,099.99.
test_cases.expected_result: The claim is not recommended for automatic approval and is routed to manual_review with reason code HIGH_VALUE.

test_cases.title: Claim exactly at its category limit is handled as high value
preconditions: The claim category limit is 1,100.00.
steps: Submit a claim for 1,100.00.

test_cases.title: Claim above 1,000 and above its category limit uses OVER_LIMIT
preconditions: The system accepts claim amounts to two decimal places.
The claim category limit is 1,100.00.
steps: Submit a claim for 1,100.01.
test_cases.expected_result: The claim is not recommended for automatic approval and is routed with reason code OVER_LIMIT, not HIGH_VALUE. The destination is not specified by the acceptance criteria for this case.

test_cases.title: Claim above its category limit but not above 1,000 uses OVER_LIMIT
preconditions: The system accepts claim amounts to two decimal places.

steps: Submit a claim for 900.01.

test_cases.title: Appeal a declined claim by replying to the decision letter
preconditions: The member has received a decision letter declining a claim.
steps: Reply to the decision letter with an appeal that states why the member thinks the decision is wrong.
test_cases.expected_result: The member can appeal the declined claim by replying to the decision letter, and the appeal states why the member thinks the decision is wrong.

test_cases.title: Appeal a declined claim through the member portal
preconditions: The member has a declined claim.
steps: Submit an appeal through the member portal that states why the member thinks the decision is wrong.
test_cases.expected_result: The member can appeal the declined claim through the member portal, and the appeal states why the member thinks the decision is wrong.

test_cases.title: Include a missing referral in the appeal
preconditions: The member has a declined claim.
A referral was missing from the original claim.
steps: Submit an appeal stating why the member thinks the decision is wrong and include the referral.
test_cases.expected_result: The appeal states why the member thinks the decision is wrong and includes the missing referral.

test_cases.title: Include a missing pre-authorisation number in the appeal
preconditions: The member has a declined claim.
A pre-authorisation number was missing from the original claim.
steps: Submit an appeal stating why the member thinks the decision is wrong and include the pre-authorisation number.
test_cases.expected_result: The appeal states why the member thinks the decision is wrong and includes the missing pre-authorisation number.

test_cases.title: Include a provider description of an accidental injury
preconditions: The member has a declined claim.
A provider description showing that an injury was accidental was missing from the original claim.
steps: Submit an appeal stating why the member thinks the decision is wrong and include the provider's description.
test_cases.expected_result: The appeal states why the member thinks the decision is wrong and includes the provider's description showing the injury was accidental.

test_cases.title: Submit an appeal without stating why the decision is wrong
preconditions: The member has a declined claim.
steps: Submit an appeal without stating why the member thinks the decision is wrong.
test_cases.expected_result: Check whether the appeal contains a reason why the member thinks the decision is wrong. The acceptance criteria do not specify how an appeal without a reason is handled.

test_cases.title: Have the appeal reviewed by an independent senior claims assessor
preconditions: The member has appealed a declined claim.
The original decision was made by a claims assessor.
steps: Review the assignment and reviewer details for the appeal.
test_cases.expected_result: The appeal is reviewed by a senior claims assessor who was not involved in the original decision.

test_cases.title: Check that the original decision-maker does not review the appeal
preconditions: The member has appealed a declined claim.
The original decision-maker is a claims assessor.
steps: Check whether the appeal reviewer is the original decision-maker.
test_cases.expected_result: The appeal reviewer is not the original decision-maker and is a senior claims assessor.

test_cases.title: Handle dissatisfaction with service as a complaint
preconditions: The member is dissatisfied with the service but is not disputing a claim decision.
steps: Submit the member's concern about the service.
test_cases.expected_result: The concern is handled as a complaint, not as an appeal.
